description: This file defines the ModuleClassLoader class, a specialized class loader for managing module resources, dependencies, and class loading in the OpenMRS modular environment. It includes mechanisms for resource inclusion based on versioning, caching libraries, expanding resources from jars, and managing module dependencies.

classes.name: ModuleClassLoader
classes.description: A custom class loader extending URLClassLoader tailored for modular application support in OpenMRS, handling resource loading, dependency management, caching, and class visibility across modules.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the Module associated with this class loader.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the class loader, clearing caches and marking it as disposed.

methods.name: setProbeParentLoaderLast
methods.description: Configures whether to probe the parent class loader after attempting to load locally.

methods.name: modulesSetChanged
methods.description: Refreshes the class loader's resource URLs based on module dependencies and libraries.

methods.name: getProvidedPackages
methods.description: Returns the set of package names provided by this module for use in class loading decisions.
